One row per attribute option value, with a slug per language. attribute_definitions.options is a flat JSON list, so option values had nowhere to store a slug or translation. This is ALSO the normalisation table: 256GB / 256 GB / 256gb / 256 all map to one row, which is what stops a facet page missing its own inventory.

Editorial content for catalog landing pages. One row per catalog entity per market. Generated by the AI pipeline; manual edits are preserved because regeneration is gated on source_hash.

One leasable row per node to enrich. Drained across many cron invocations; the lease is what makes a 300s route ceiling survivable.
One row per enrichment run. Holds the plan, the budget ceiling, the spend ledger and the circuit breaker. The queue rows below are the actual units of work.
